verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Algolia's Search API is used to manage indices and records (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-31) and that data can be synced via integrations/Crawler with 'schedule, retries, and transformations' handled by Algolia (algolia-docs-48, algolia-docs-37/38), implying pipeline-style ingestion, but there is no explicit mention of async task IDs, a waitTask-style completion check, or documented throughput for millions of records. Community evidence only touches on record-limit multiplication (algolia-comm-19) and cost-at-scale complaints (algolia-comm-5/7), not indexing speed or task-status APIs. Missing for 10: explicit async task/job ID tracking documentation, bulk-import performance benchmarks, and confirmation of large-scale (millions of docs) import behavior.
